{{Quote|I'll wager you never knew the Devaronians count baking among their many skills.|From the menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex's" />}}
'''Devaronian's food cake''' was a type of [[Cake/Legends|cake]] made by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]],<ref name="Dex's" /> a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]].<ref name="Alien Races">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> Besides being edible to members of the Devaronian species, the dessert dish could also be eaten by individuals belonging to the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Besalisk" />

Created by the Devaronian species, Devaronian's food cake was one of many [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]] discovered and enjoyed by the Besalisk [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] in his life, during which he spent [[Standard year/Legends|years]] traveling throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The food cake was eventually served by the Besalisk [[Chef/Legends|chef]] at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] he owned in [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Dex's" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> Jettster served the cake as one of the restaurant's desserts for 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a slice.<ref name="Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Devaronian's food cake was featured in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the form of an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="Dex's" />
